name: Seku Satoru 2
source: The protagonist visits a certain shrine. He has been praying fervently, his heart filled with the desire for a harem. On his 108th visit, a voice claiming to be a god finally answers him..
translation: The protagonist visits a certain shrine. He has been praying fervently, his heart filled with the desire for a harem. On his 108th visit, a voice claiming to be a god finally answers him..
